extracted.intended_audience: web publishers, editors, and anyone seeking to republish ProPublica stories
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and requirements for republishing this ProPublica story online or elsewhere, including attribution, technical/linking requirements, allowed edits, and prohibited uses. Targets publishers or sites that want to repost ProPublica content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative Commons license
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The story is offered under CC BY-NC-ND 3.0; attribution, non-commercial use, and no derivatives requirements apply. ProPublica also lists additional specific republication rules below.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attribution / byline requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You have to credit ProPublica and any co-reporting partners. In the byline, we prefer 'Author Name, Publication(s).' At the top of the text of your story, include a line that reads: 'This story was originally published by ProPublica.' You must link the word 'ProPublica' to the original URL of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the preferred byline format exactly when possible; include the explicit 'originally published' line and make 'ProPublica' a hyperlink to the original story URL.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include original links and PixelPing tag when republishing online
rubrics_metrics.description: If you're republishing online, you must link to the URL of this story on propublica.org, include all of the links from our story, including our newsletter sign up language and link, and use our PixelPing tag.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preserve all links present in the original article (including newsletter signup) and ensure PixelPing tag is present; maintain link targets to ProPublica's URLs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canonical metadata requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If you use canonical metadata, please use the ProPublica URL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set canonical URL to the ProPublica story URL so search engines treat the ProPublica page as the canonical source. ProPublica references a Google SEO link for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: You can't edit our material, except to reflect relative changes in time, location and editorial style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permitted small updates: change 'yesterday' to 'last week,' or 'Portland, Ore.' to 'Portland' or 'here.' Substantive edits, rewrites, or deletions are not allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photograph and illustration permission
rubrics_metrics.description: You cannot republish our photographs or illustrations without specific permission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact [email protected] to request permission for images or illustrations; do not assume image rights are covered by article license.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad placement and fundraising restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: It's okay to put our stories on pages with ads, but not ads specifically sold against our stories. You can't state or imply that donations to your organization support ProPublica's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure ads are not targeted/sold as associated with the ProPublica story and avoid any language suggesting donor support to your org funds ProPublica.

rubrics_metrics.name: No separate sale or syndication
rubrics_metrics.description: You can't sell our material separately or syndicate it. This includes publishing or syndicating our work on platforms or apps such as Apple News, Google News, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not place the story behind paywalls or package it as a separate product; do not republish via syndication platforms without contacting ProPublica for licensing.

rubrics_metrics.name: No wholesale or automatic republishing
rubrics_metrics.description: You can't republish our material wholesale, or automatically; you need to select stories to be republished individually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bulk, automated ingestion of ProPublica stories is prohibited. For syndication or licensing inquiries, contact ProPublica at [email protected].

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on SEO/revenue-only use
rubrics_metrics.description: You can't use our work to populate a website designed to improve rankings on search engines or solely to gain revenue from network-based advertisements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use ProPublica content as filler for SEO manipulation or ad-network revenue schemes; republication must be in a legitimate editorial context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not generally permit translation of our stories into another language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you want to translate, seek explicit permission; translations are not covered by the general republishing permission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contactability requirement for hosting sites
rubrics_metrics.description: Any website our stories appear on must include a prominent and effective way to contact you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide visible contact information (email or other) on the page/site hosting the republished story so ProPublica or readers can reach the republisher.
